actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong, FDR-significant immune activation and metabolic suppression pathways (large effect sizes, consistent direction). WXS BAP1 enrichment and CNV changes provide supportive but weaker evidence. Technical confounders show no significant association, and known-label overlap is minimal. Although cross-modal silhouettes are low, RNA provides a strong primary signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 shows a coherent reciprocal RNA-defined biological identity (immune suppression, metabolic activation) with strong FDR-significant pathway effect sizes, complementary to C0001. WXS shows significant BAP1 depletion, and CNV changes mirror C0001. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Despite low cross-modal silhouettes, RNA provides a strong primary signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.
